notes.title: Command list update
notes.notes:
You can now view the available commands in the current level by typing “?” into the command box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44821900/ef9b10db71e9b09da4d34b6a419dd894e728f7a7.png[/img]
Note that each command has several alternate versions, but this tip only includes one for each for the sake of readability.

notes.title: Minor quality-of-life updates
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added extra instructions on the barn and eye encounters to make it clear that they aren’t an escape room, but a sit-and-survive minigame.
[*] Changed the graveyard theme to torture your ears less. The old version has been included in the soundtrack.
[*] Added a few extra alternative command options on the starter levels.
[/list]

notes.title: It’s done.
notes.notes:
4 years later, Until it’s Undone returns in its final form. I had to brace the horrors of seeing old code, now you have to face the horrors of the lost town.

A short-but-sweet ride of eldritch sarcasm.

Welcome back.

notes.title: Delay.
notes.notes:
I really shouldn’t have joked about Murphy’s law.

Now, the actual game is completed and running fine. The reason for the delay is that I actually managed to get a testing team this time and we decided to take some time to review the game’s localizations to perfect them. Which sounds like a short task on paper, but turns out people have lives. The new tentative release date would be February 9-10.
